title: Decide the test host: iOS unit target vs. SwiftReadability SPM package
roadmap_anchor: Q2 > Open source > Extract SwiftReadability as an SPM package
acceptance: A written decision recorded in DESIGN.md under Open
If SPM: Stacks/Content and the pure-logic parts of Stacks/Services move to a local package whose tests run via `swift test` on macOS with no simulator
If iOS target: accept that the sim lock serializes the gate and cap max_parallel accordingly
notes: Gates every Phase 1 task. An iOS unit-test target needs a booted simulator, so the sim lock serializes the gate and largely defeats parallelism. Extracting the extractor (Content/*, ~1700 lines, the most fixture-driven code in the repo) as a local SPM package makes the gate seconds-long, simulator-free, and parallel-safe. It also pulls a Q2 roadmap item forward. Human decision, never dispatched.
